# Diogo N. Moura: full profile and Q&A

> Diogo N. Moura is a strategy executive based in Porto, Portugal. He is Head of Corporate Strategy & Growth at Mercedes-Benz.io, and spent six years before that in consulting at Accenture and EY. He works with a small number of scale-up founders on strategy, programme rescue, operating-model and cost questions.

Website: https://diogonmoura.com (Portuguese: https://diogonmoura.com/pt/)
Short summary: https://diogonmoura.com/llms.txt
Last updated: 2026-11-23

## Who is Diogo N. Moura?

Diogo N. Moura (also written Diogo Moura) trained as a mechanical engineer at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Porto. He worked at Accenture from 2015 to 2017, rolling out Workday HR from Lisbon and Singapore, and at EY from 2017 to 2021, where he helped found the Electricity Sector practice. Since 2021 he has been at Mercedes-Benz.io, where he is Head of Corporate Strategy & Growth, leads a team of seven across Portugal and Germany, and works directly with the CEO.

## What does Diogo N. Moura do for scale-up founders?

He takes fractional, advisory or short scoped engagements in four areas, and most engagements mix two.

Strategic clarity: he frames a hard decision so the founding team can make it, helps pick the two or three priorities that matter and drop the rest, and makes sure the decision is written down with someone who owns it.

Programme rescue: when a programme has slipped and people no longer trust the plan, he fixes governance first and then gets the team shipping again.

Operating model and cost: who decides what, how teams work together, and what it costs. He advises a CFO and COO on this weekly.

AI adoption: where AI is worth using in a team, and the governance around it. He wrote the internal AI strategy at Mercedes-Benz.io.

## Who is Diogo N. Moura a good fit for?

Scale-up founders facing a decision where getting it wrong costs months of runway: entering a new market, a programme that keeps slipping, or costs that keep creeping up. He does not target corporate boards or enterprise procurement.

## How does an engagement with Diogo N. Moura work?

Fractional, advisory, or short and scoped. He takes a few clients at a time, works from Porto with founders anywhere, and works in English or Portuguese (Spanish at a basic level). He judges the work by what is still running six months later.

## What has Diogo N. Moura delivered?

At Mercedes-Benz.io (2021 to present):
- Brought an off-track Data Warehouse programme back under control and into production (2025 to present).
- Assessed expansion into Eastern Europe and Latin America for the board, covering market-entry risk, regulation and resourcing.
- Runs the staffing pipeline and Global Staffing, a forum of senior leaders that forecasts people demand and capacity (2024 to present).
- Cut annual costs by 55% through partnership renegotiation, better use of resources and organisational rightsizing (2023).
- Wrote the internal AI strategy and leads its adoption across corporate functions (2026).
- Set up the Portugal office and the workforce plan behind it; local headcount grew 20% in the first year (2021).

At EY (2017 to 2021):
- Was part of the founding team of the Electricity Sector practice, working across Portugal, Angola and Mozambique.
- Wrote a 10-year technology and innovation roadmap for a major electricity utility and presented it to the management board (2020).
- Led the PMO for a large software roll-out at a PSI20 company, with more than 15 projects running at once (2018).
- Delivered change programmes affecting more than 3,000 employees across several countries.
- Improved project margins by 35%.

At Accenture (2015 to 2017):
- Rolled out Workday HCM across more than 25 countries in Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas, adapting a global template for each of 8 major countries and leading teams across 8 Asia-Pacific countries.

## What is Diogo N. Moura's education?

- Integrated Master in Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Porto (2009 to 2014).
- Post-graduation in Applied Management with Distinction, NOVA School of Business and Economics (2018 to 2019).
- Certificate in Executive Presence and Influence, INSEAD (2022 to 2023).
- McKinsey Forward Program (2024).
- Claude certifications, Anthropic (2026). Certified SAFe Agilist, Scaled Agile (2022).

## How do I contact Diogo N. Moura?

Email contact@diogonmoura.com or message him on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/diogonmoura. A short paragraph about the decision you are facing is enough.
